scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:tokens && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.build: pnpm prepare:example && pnpm generate:tokens && pnpm check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.storybook: pnpm prepare:example && pnpm generate:tokens && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 storybook dev -p 6008 --host 127.0.0.1 --no-open
scripts.build:storybook: pnpm prepare:example && pnpm generate:tokens && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 storybook build --disable-telemetry
scripts.test: pnpm generate:tokens && pnpm check && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./tests/alias.mjs --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:cloudflare: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/openuji/journey-viewer.git .journey-viewer && pnpm --dir .journey-viewer install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir .journey-viewer build && pnpm build
